input.intent: Preserve Three Sword Style, cutting attacks including ranged slashes, and Haki swordsmanship. Consider Ashura and King of Hell where evidence supports them. Build a playable kit with at least 15 meaningful purchasable upgrades that each change executable behavior. Select a coherent subset instead of claiming exhaustive coverage. Disclose omitted defining abilities and any source limits. Treat numerical damage, costs, cooldowns, range, targeting and unlock progression as explicit gameplay adaptations. Do not invent character powers to meet upgrade count; deepen sourced abilities where possible.

context.evidencePurpose: Curated development demonstration, available to generation and review; not an unseen benchmark.
context.reviewScope: Selected manga continuity through end of Wano; exclude later manga, anime-only and game-only facts from this request.
context.priorReviewCorrections: Use only schema-supported attack shapes. A projectile cannot use sweep; multi-hit Techniques cannot use sweep or area. A pulse stuns; it does not deal damage. Pulse cycles counts successful primary contacts per trigger, not bursts.
context.descriptionAgreement: Descriptions must state the scope of the actual executable modifiers. Unsupported history dependence, target senses, recoil, movement and elemental status must remain explicit omissions.

research.subject: Roronoa Zoro
gaps: The selected schema has no fields for a playable kit, purchasable upgrades, attack shapes, costs, damage, cooldowns, range, targeting or unlock progression. No 15-upgrade tree is therefore represented.

The supplied pages do not provide evidence for numerical damage, resource costs, cooldowns, exact ranges, targeting rules, hit counts, pulse behavior, sweep or area classifications, progression requirements, recoil, movement modifiers or elemental status effects. These would be explicit gameplay adaptations rather than character evidence.

The guidance requests a coherent playable subset, but the supplied pages do not provide enough detailed descriptions for a complete catalogue of every named technique. Only techniques and forms with usable descriptions in the supplied text were retained; many other named attacks are omitted.

The supplied material does not establish that Zoro generates fire, applies a fire status, senses specific target categories, or gains history-dependent bonuses. Foxfire evidence supports cutting flames, not creating or inflicting elemental effects.

The ability page contains later manga material, anime references and non-canon material. Egghead-era claims, anime-only demonstrations and non-canon entries were excluded from the requested continuity.

The evidence is a secondary ability-page compilation plus an official profile rather than supplied manga panels or chapter excerpts. Exact wording, chronology and technique mechanics should be checked against the manga if stricter primary-source verification is required.

The runtime executes stationary direct contact, traveling projectiles and ally healing with caller-supplied motion and injury. The optional canonical mechanics block executes actors, projectile graphs, statuses, income and range support. Defensive combat and automatic moving-path simulation remain outside the adapter.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.
